guard: every file that defaults COTAL_SERVERS and then calls configFromEnv() on process.env must drop the COTAL_LAUNCH_MATERIAL pointer first
why: Issue #995. A launcher-spawned seat exports COTAL_LAUNCH_MATERIAL. A suite that then
defaults COTAL_SERVERS and calls configFromEnv() on process.env manufactures the two-carrier
launch the connector refuses. The ambient-env census cannot see this: it grades spreads into
children, and the refusal happens in the suite's OWN process.
N1 restores the reported defect: hermes tool-parity loses its pointer drop. It must redden
the per-file cell, which is the census's only real output for a missing drop.
N2 is order, not presence. A drop after configFromEnv still looks like a scrub and still
throws. The cell that names 'before configFromEnv' is the one that has to go red.
N3 is the census shrinking silently. Every per-file cell is generated from the census, so
walking only connector-hermes deletes cells rather than failing them, and a suite with
fewer cells still exits 0. The package-span cell is what makes that red.
NO BUILD STEP: the suite reads source files off disk and imports nothing from a built
package, so there is no dist/ copy that could disagree with the mutation.

mutations.name: N1 hermes tool-parity loses its COTAL_LAUNCH_MATERIAL drop, which is the reported defect
mutations.replace:
const config = configFromEnv();
const specNames = cotalToolSpecs(config, "hermes").map((s) => s.name);
mutations.note: The exact regression #995 names. Without the drop, a managed seat's pnpm test manufactures the two-carrier launch and is refused.

mutations.name: N2 the drop sits AFTER configFromEnv, so the pair is still present when the refusal runs
mutations.expectRed: extensions/connector-core/smoke/tool-input-closed.smoke.ts drops the pointer before configFromEnv() reads the pair
mutations.cell: extensions/connector-core/smoke/tool-input-closed.smoke.ts drops the pointer before configFromEnv() reads the pair
mutations.note: Presence-not-position: the drop is still in the file, so a census that only asked 'is the line there' would stay green while the live refusal still fires.

mutations.name: N3 the census is scoped to connector-hermes, the package that reported the defect
mutations.expectRed: the census spans more than one package directory, so it is keyed on content and not on one connector
mutations.cell: the census spans more than one package directory, so it is keyed on content and not on one connector
mutations.note: Narrowing the walk does not FAIL the per-file cells, it stops emitting them. A suite with two files instead of six still exits 0 unless the span cell fires.
